title.narrative: Building Effective Health Systems for Malaria Control - Ghana (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Ghana, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Ghana (Ghana MOH)This program has the following goals: Reduce malaria mortality by 90% by the year 2028 (using 2022 as baseline). Reduce malaria case incidence by 50% by 2028 (using 2022 as baseline). To achieve malaria elimination in 21 districts by 2028. The objectives of this program are: To ensure 100% of the population have adequate knowledge, attitudes, practices and requisite skills for malaria elimination by 2028. To ensure 100% of the population use at least one malaria preventive measure. To ensure that 100% of malaria cases are identified by parasitological tests and treatment initiated within 24 hours by 2028. To ensure that 100% of all confirmed malaria cases are appropriately, effectively and completely treated within 72 hours by 2028. To strengthen passive and active surveillance and monitoring and evaluation systems by 2028. To ensure that 100% of all active foci of infection in very low transmission areas are identified and eliminated through intensified surveillance, targeted vector control and environmental management and human parasite reservoir interventions by 2028. To ensure timely and adequate supply of quality-assured malaria commodities to all service delivery points by 2028. To strengthen and maintain capacity for governance and program management to achieve programmatic objectives at all levels of the health care system towards malaria elimination by 2028.. To improve mobilization of resources and efficiently use available resources towards malaria elimination
